messages:
Maria (PM): Drafting a compliance-focused one-pager for regulated customers (healthcare & finance). Goal: quick sales enable + gated landing. Need messaging on SLAs, private deploy, and KMS.
Jon (GTM): +1. Can we lead with 'Compliance-first deployments for production LLMs'? Short headline, then 3 bullets: security, SLA, deployment modes.
Ashley (Design): I'll mock a hero with a 3-column comparison. Do we have simple benchmark numbers to call out? latency / uptime / cost delta.
Samir (SalesAE): From pilots: Dedicated had 99.95% uptime (observed), median p95 latency ~130ms for 4k context. Cost: ~35-45% lower per-token vs client-managed single-node. I'll pull the exact slides.
Maria (PM): Nice. For the one-pager keep numbers as 'Redwood-verified' not internal model names. Also add a tiny flow diagram showing request routing -> fallbacks -> KV cache.
Jon (GTM): Webinar tie-in: 30-min 'How we meet SLAs for regulated apps' with a customer panel + short demo of Private deploy onboarding. CTA: 'Request compliance review' -> collects industry, compliance standard, region.
Ashley (Design): Two output formats? 1) single PDF one-pager for field, 2) HTML landing with tracked CTA. Landing preferred for inbound routing and AB tests.
marketing-bot: Friendly reminder — design freeze for sprint next Thursday. Assets due by 09:00 PST on the 14th. :calendar:
Samir (SalesAE): On the benchmarks narrative: avoid model branding, emphasize workload types (chat, summarization) and constrained SLAs. Add note about burst capacity & canary fallbacks.
Maria (PM): Also include a short 'What to expect during onboarding' checklist: network setup, KMS, compliance review, SLA kick-off. Make it a 4-step timeline.
Lina (Legal): Quick note: please use 'SLA-backed uptime subject to terms' and link to the legal terms. I'll review the final phrasing by EOD tomorrow.
Ashley (Design): Draft comps in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/compliance-onepager — drop comments on the canvas, I'll iterate.
Jon (GTM): Inbound routing: landing -> forms -> Salesforce lead with 'compliance' flag -> assign to Security Solutions AE queue. We should add that process to the AE playbook.
Maria (PM): OK next steps: Samir delivers benchmark bullets by EOD tomorrow; Ashley finalizes two comps; Jon drafts webinar outline and landing copy; Lina approves legal snippet. I’ll consolidate into the one-pager and share final PDF. :thumbsup:
